tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search official business registries (NY, CO, OR, CT, PA) and the GLEIF LEI index for a company name. Returns status, entity type, formation date, address, registered agent and officers where published. Takes ~5-10s. $0.02 per call after the free daily quota.

tools.name: list_company_sources
tools.description: Free. Lists the official registries this server searches.
